This is an original raster pixel-art interpretation. All six face LEFT, side view. Left column: identical icy vishap color across all three, muted steel-blue scales, large sharp CYAN crystals, pale glacial belly. Right column: identical thunder vishap across all three, dark plum charcoal scales, curved VIOLET dorsal spikes and sharp lilac back crystals, pale violet-grey belly. TOP ROW: each lizard crouches low close to the ground with back arched and tail curled up high, ready to sweep. MIDDLE ROW: each is in a low grounded stretched stance, head at left with conspicuously open jaws and tight bright throat for a projectile breath, tail far right. BOTTOM ROW: each jumps with tucked forelegs and feet off ground, neck pointed down-left, long tail trailing upward-right, clear legs in air. Consistent giant lizard proportions across all three, four limbs, no wings, crisp deliberately squared pixels, sharp black/purple outlines and broad color blocks. No shadow floor, cues, sparkles, explosion, projectile, lettering, cell lines, border, text, background, fog or glow beyond the creature edge. Actual alpha.
